output.summary: The lease requires a 36-month term with $11,250/month rent. The user plans to sublease 40% (1,800 sq ft) of the 4,500 sq ft floor for 3 months, keeping 60% occupancy. Clause 12.4 grants the landlord an absolute, immediate recapture option upon any sublease notice, which directly conflicts with the user's need to maintain occupancy for the full term.
key_claims: Recapture option allows immediate termination upon any sublease notice
risks_or_flaws: Landlord's absolute recapture option upon any sublease notice violates the requirement to maintain 60% occupancy for the full 36-month term
output.verification_question: Does the landlord's absolute recapture option (Clause 12.4) permit the tenant to sublease 40% of the floor while retaining 60% occupancy for the entire 36-month term?
